rescoreNote: An earlier pass by this verifier scored a seven-item subset and awarded PASS_COMPLETE_INDEPENDENT to ten families on that narrower reading. Lane contract L9 forbids exactly that, so all twelve subjects were re-scored against the canonical fifteen by name. The result is materially different and is not a relabelling: six families fail, four pass, and two carry the strongest verdict. Git history preserves the superseded rows.
corpusNote: private/ does not exist in this container, so no Master Library byte could be rehashed. SOURCE_IDENTITY is therefore NOT_MEASURABLE_HERE for the nine families that bind corpus bytes, and each of those rows stops at PASS rather than claiming an exact-source pass it did not measure. Three families - vt_exp_deferred_sentence-set, vt_seal_under_25-set and me-nonconv-set - bind no corpus bytes at all (their receipts record that the MASTER_QUEUE row binds none), so every source they do bind is a committed repository record; all of those were rehashed here and matched on both SHA-256 and byte length, and those families carry a measured SOURCE_IDENTITY pass.
method: Independent second reads of twelve families this verifier did not build, at the base sha recorded in each lane's rows.json. Per family: claim asserted through claim.mjs before any artifact was read and released after the verdict; verify-packet-completeness.mjs run fresh; artifact bytes rehashed; page counts read from the PDF bytes with pdfinfo and compared against the artifact record and the page manifest; every recorded write value searched for in text extracted from that fixture's own bytes; word geometry extracted with pdftotext -bbox and checked against the page box and against every same-baseline word pair; route keys compared across field map, wiring, MASTER_QUEUE and the canonical route universe; and participant-instructions.md plus the packet faces read for destination, fee, service and stop. No counter was copied from a builder self-report.

standardApplied.FILING_DESTINATION: Met when the instructions, or a participant-facing page, name the court, clerk or agency the route names. A prefilled caption identifying a court type is evidence, not the instructions naming a destination.
standardApplied.FEE_AND_WAIVER: Met when the packet states the filing fee AND a waiver route. A fee printed on a form the packet fills and selects counts; a statute stating no fee is payable counts, and where no fee is payable there is no waiver to name. An instruction to ask someone what the fee is does not count.
standardApplied.SERVICE: Met when the packet states who must be served and by what method. A rule that the participant serves nobody, stated affirmatively with the mechanism that replaces it, counts. An instruction to ask the clerk who must be served does not.
standardApplied.consistencyNote: This is the standard already recorded in this factory - the VF10 row on ut_pet_traffic-set and the VERMONT_REPAIR evidence for VF01/VF02 both apply it. VERMONT_REPAIR.json records that FILING_DESTINATION was once scored FAIL by two verifiers and PASS by a third on identical bytes; the standard is therefore stated here rather than left implicit.

crossFamilyReconciliation: Twelve families, six distinct defects, and four of the six reach two families each through a shared host: the two Georgia families share one unresolved fee paragraph, the two DC families share one fee paragraph and one prosecutor-routing paragraph, and the two Kentucky void-and-seal families share all four of their failures. Six FAIL rows are therefore three repairs.

The Kentucky route-key defect is the only one where the packet contradicts itself rather than declining to answer: the field map and the printed face carry a key that does not exist in the canonical route universe while the wiring and the MASTER_QUEUE row carry the one that does.

FEE_AND_WAIVER is the single most common failure in these two lanes (six of twelve families). Two families answer it well and show what the standard looks like when met: ky_felony_vacatur_expungement-set quotes both fee amounts from the form's own face with the statutory subsections and names the in forma pauperis route, and the two Vermont families state the fee as zero on statutory authority rather than on an absence of information.

grantsNothing: A PASS_COMPLETE_INDEPENDENT verdict proves a packet is complete. It approves no output, opens no commercial route, and promotes nothing past state_built; approved_for_live and live remain gated on visual and counsel review, and on a hash-bound RASTER_PASS this lane did not run.
